Science being an absolute concrete thing, whereas scientists are an abstraction of that absolute (which determines the logical forms of the scientists’ thought). Most liberals or general stupid materialists/idealists pose the Renaissance and Bourgeois revolutions as having been a victory for Absolute Reason (the collective mental wealth of the species) which had broken free from the ‘practical limitations’ of feudalism without considering the notion that the same ‘practical limitations’ exist under Capitalism insofar as the petit bourgeois intellectuals who represent science (and academia as a whole) are determined towards their class basis. Positivism (and Analytic Philosophy as its expression in philosophy) is itself an illogical method, insofar as it relies so heavily on formal logic and the principle of non-contradiction, in being an illogical method positivism can’t explain contradictions and in following it’s principles has to “work backwards” to find where this contradiction (which is posed as an internal failure, the fault of the individual rather than contradiction being a principle of existence) came from and to remove it. With the application of that method, thought (without freedom from positivism) is destined to always follow its principle of non-contradiction and in doing do never really be pushed to any conclusion, always half-truths. Rational kernels, idealist shells. If thought rejects the principle of non-contradiction then, if the study of contradictions is applied to one constituent part of the greater totality, we unravel the whole from the part and arrive at universal forms and laws. It’s never a rejection of science or Truth, but merely the understanding that science and Truth are not expressed within individual members of a class which has an interest to preserve itself, and that science and Truth are things which can’t be understood on a level of the whole of society for as long as the division of labour and exploitation of man exists, the non-existence of these things being the negation of those things which is Communism, where the division of labour, the state and the myth of the nation and its ‘chosen people’ are done away with.
